REQUIRED_TRANSITION_PRECONDITIONS: MISSION_FENCE_STATE exists and is authoritative for TARGET_AUTHORITY_KEY.
CLOSURE_STATE is not an active closure barrier or pinned-world sweep.
Old SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH and SHARD_UNIVERSE_VERSION exactly match the migration intent source universe.
New shard-universe artifact and deterministic routing/mapping rules are immutable and independently hash-verifiable before entry.
MIGRATED_DOMAIN_MANIFEST_RULES: Enumerate every canonical bulk-state domain whose routing depends on SHARD_UNIVERSE, including at minimum membership, messages, tasks, evidence, findings/projection artifacts, and reviews when those domains are sharded by the active control implementation.
For each domain bind immutable record identity rule, old routing rule, new routing rule, source denominator root/count, and migration output root/count.
A domain not using SHARD_UNIVERSE routing must be explicitly marked NOT_SHARD_UNIVERSE_ROUTED with evidence; omission is invalid.

ENTRY_CAS.EXPECTED: Mission Fence STATE_VERSION and all preconditions above still match.
ENTRY_CAS.EFFECT: All old normal memberships/leases/writers lose mutation eligibility before any U2 canonical routing is exposed.

OLD_UNIVERSE_FREEZE: After ENTRY_CAS, no new normal work, mutation lease, integration reservation, or normal membership may be admitted under U1.
Every sharded writer must re-read the authoritative Mission Fence before a write; closed gates/epoch mismatch reject stale writers.

For sharded control transports, each U1 shard/domain publishes an immutable freeze acknowledgement bound to transition id, ENGINEERING_EPOCH, MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH, old universe hash/version, exact shard head/snapshot id, and writer-drain generation.
Freeze acknowledgement and shard writes must share one authoritative CAS/transaction domain or equivalent fencing token so a writer that read pre-freeze state cannot commit after freeze.
Every old shard is represented, including explicit empty shards for closure-relevant domains.
MIGRATION_BUILD: Materialize migration from immutable frozen U1 shard snapshots only.
Recompute each record's U2 destination from immutable canonical record identity and the bound routing algorithm.
Do not mutate canonical record identity while moving records.
For every migrated domain create a sorted manifest containing record id, source U1 shard, source artifact identity, destination U2 shard, destination artifact identity, and migration disposition.
Require source denominator count/root == migrated unique record count/root after canonical identity projection; zero omissions and zero duplicate canonical identities.
Build explicit empty U2 shard manifests where the active domain/closure contract requires full shard enumeration.
Migration writes populate a candidate U2 namespace that has no normal writer authority before cutover.
VERIFY_BEFORE_CUTOVER: Every U1 shard/domain freeze acknowledgement is valid and still matches its frozen source snapshot.
No post-freeze authoritative U1 write exists; any ambiguity aborts/restarts transition.
Every migrated domain proves one-to-one identity preservation and no omission/duplication.
Candidate U2 manifests and routing outputs recompute to the expected NEW_SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH/VERSION and migration roots.
Independent review/test evidence for the migration generation is present.
ACTIVE_INTEGRATION remains null and closure remains inactive.

CUTOVER_CAS.LINEARIZATION_POINT: The Mission Fence expected-version CAS that installs NEW_SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH/VERSION after verified migration.
CUTOVER_CAS.EXPECTED: Transition id/state, ENGINEERING_EPOCH, MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH, old universe, gates, and STATE_VERSION still match the verified migration snapshot.
CUTOVER_CAS.RULE: No normal U2 mutation authority exists before this CAS; no normal U1 mutation authority exists after ENTRY_CAS. Therefore canonical normal-writer authority has no overlapping U1/U2 interval.

POST_CUTOVER_REBIND: U1 namespaces become immutable historical evidence and recovery input only.
Existing pre-entry memberships remain stale because MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH changed.
Chats renew/create ACTIVE memberships under current MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH and current SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH/VERSION before normal mutation.

New leases bind current ENGINEERING_EPOCH and renewed membership generations; operational lease schema must also bind current SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH/VERSION or a transition/cutover generation that uniquely implies them.
Normal work-loop revalidation must include current SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH/VERSION or the uniquely binding cutover generation before mutation.
Only after rebind verification may WORK_ADMISSION_GATE/MUTATION_GATE/INTEGRATION_GATE reopen and TRANSITION_KIND return to NONE via Mission Fence CAS.
CLOSURE_RULES: Closure entry is forbidden while TRANSITION_KIND == SHARD_UNIVERSE_UPDATE or migration state is ambiguous/incomplete.
After cutover, closure uses U2 only after verified migration manifests prove every canonical U1 record is represented or explicitly terminal/historical under U2 accounting.
Migration manifests themselves are closure-relevant dependency/control evidence and must be retained.
CRASH_RECOVERY: Crash before ENTRY_CAS: no authority change; discard/revalidate candidate intent.
Crash after ENTRY_CAS before all U1 freezes: gates remain closed; resume freeze/drain or abort through an explicit reconciled rollback transition without restoring stale memberships.
Crash after U1 frozen during migration: resume from immutable U1 snapshots; never reopen U1 writers to simplify recovery.
Crash after migration verification but before CUTOVER_CAS: revalidate every frozen-source and candidate-root binding before retrying CUTOVER_CAS.
Crash after CUTOVER_CAS before rebind: U2 is canonical but gates remain closed; resume membership/lease rebind and validation.
If actual shard/control transport state cannot be reconciled to either verified pre-cutover U1 or committed U2, transition becomes UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION and gates remain closed.
REQUIRED_TORTURE_TESTS: Paused U1 writer reads valid state before ENTRY_CAS, resumes after U1 freeze, and its write is rejected by epoch/fencing CAS.
Membership/message/task/evidence write storms during entry barrier cannot create canonical post-freeze U1 records.
Crash after 1 of N U1 shards freezes.
Crash after candidate U2 records are partially materialized.
Duplicate record deliberately routed to two U2 shards is detected by canonical identity manifest.
Source U1 record deliberately omitted from migration is detected by denominator root/count mismatch.
Cutover CAS races a stale transition writer and only one Mission Fence state wins.
Post-cutover old membership/lease attempts mutation and is rejected.
Closure attempt during migration is rejected.
Closure after cutover includes every U2 shard, explicit empty shards, and all migrated canonical records.
ACCEPTANCE_FOR_FINDING_RESOLUTION: Independent reviewer confirms no compliant stale U1 writer can remain canonical after ENTRY_CAS.
Independent reviewer confirms there is exactly one U1-to-U2 canonical linearization point.
Migration denominator/completeness proofs cover all SHARD_UNIVERSE-routed authoritative domains.
Crash recovery never requires blind force or erasure of ambiguous durable truth.

Real torture tests execute after activation before runtime scale safety is declared.
